restaurant-management-platform.eyebrow: SUNDAE · HOSPITALITY AND FOOD-SERVICE OPERATING PLATFORM
restaurant-management-platform.title: Restaurant management software for every shift and every location.
restaurant-management-platform.description: Sundae brings scheduling, attendance, tasks, handovers and connected operating data into one platform for multi-location hospitality and food-service groups. Run daily work with clear ownership, use intelligence to guide decisions and measure what changed.
challenges: Scheduling, attendance, tasks, handovers, payroll and performance live in separate systems with no shared operating record.
Regional leaders see isolated reports instead of the context behind an exception and the person responsible for the next action.
An operating improvement is hard to repeat when teams cannot compare what happened, what changed and what worked.
capabilities: Connected intelligence across operations and performance
Measured action and recovery of preventable profit loss
outcomes: Operators get one operating rhythm across brands, locations and teams.
Managers can act on live context while leaders see the pattern across the group.
Restaurant workflows lead into the same decision and recovery loop used across hospitality and food-service operations.

questions.question: What is restaurant management software?
questions.answer: It connects the daily systems and workflows used to run restaurant locations, including people, schedules, tasks, handovers, attendance, payroll readiness, operating data and performance review.

questions.question: Is Sundae only for restaurants?
questions.answer: Sundae supports multi-location hospitality and food-service groups, including restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens and catering operators. The same operating model connects people, daily workflows and measured decisions across the group.

questions.question: Where does AI fit into the platform?
questions.answer: AI is embedded in the operating workflow to help teams understand context, answer operating questions, recommend next actions and review what changed.

restaurant-task-management.title: Restaurant task management that survives the rush.
restaurant-task-management.description: Assign opening, closing, recurring and exception work to the right person, track completion across locations and carry the evidence into the next operating decision.
challenges: Opening and closing checklists live in paper, chat threads or spreadsheets that no one can audit later.
Regional managers see that a task was missed without seeing who owned it, what blocked it or whether the issue repeated.
A task gets completed, but the operating signal never reaches the schedule, the manager or the performance review.
capabilities: Assignments by role, site, brand or region
outcomes: Every task has an owner, a status and a visible next step.
Managers can compare execution patterns across shifts and locations.
Completed work becomes context for coaching, prioritization and measured recovery.

questions.question: What is restaurant task management software?
questions.answer: It gives restaurant teams a shared way to assign, complete, approve and review daily operating work such as opening, closing, safety, maintenance and service checklists.

questions.question: Can task management work across multiple locations?
questions.answer: Sundae Crew is designed for role, site, brand and region ownership so operators can standardize work while keeping local accountability visible.

questions.question: How does task management connect to restaurant performance?
questions.answer: Task status and evidence can become operating context for manager follow-up, exception review and the decisions measured through Sundae’s operating loop.

restaurant-logbook.eyebrow: SUNDAE CREW · LOGBOOK AND SHIFT HANDOVER
restaurant-logbook.title: A digital restaurant logbook for every shift.
restaurant-logbook.description: Keep manager notes, shift handovers, issues and follow-up in one searchable operating record, so the next team starts with context instead of guesswork.
challenges: Important handover details disappear into paper books, group chats or individual manager memory.
The same maintenance, service or staffing issue repeats because no one can find the prior context.
A note is recorded, but no owner, task or measured outcome carries it forward.
capabilities: Link notes to tasks, owners and operating context
outcomes: Every shift begins with the context the manager needs.
Regional teams can spot recurring issues instead of treating each shift as a new event.
Communication becomes a record that supports action, coaching and measured improvement.

questions.question: What is a digital restaurant logbook?
questions.answer: It is a shared operating record for shift notes, handovers, issues, manager updates and follow-up across one or more restaurant locations.

questions.question: What should a restaurant shift handover include?
questions.answer: A useful handover captures what happened, what needs attention, who owns the next action and what the incoming team should know before service.

questions.question: Can a logbook connect to restaurant task management?
questions.answer: Yes. Sundae’s operating model connects communication and follow-up so a note can lead to an assigned task, an approval or a review of the outcome.

restaurant-tip-management.title: Restaurant tip workflows ready for review.
restaurant-tip-management.description: Bring tip rules, staff context, review steps and payroll readiness into one workflow that managers and payroll teams can explain.
challenges: Tip calculations depend on rules, roles, locations and source data that are often reconciled manually.
Managers and payroll teams need to review exceptions without losing the underlying evidence.
The team can finish a payroll cycle without learning which staffing, attendance or service patterns changed the result.
capabilities: Configurable tip pool and distribution workflows
Role, location and pay-period review context
outcomes: Tip workflows become reviewable and explainable before handoff.
Managers and payroll teams share one operating record for exceptions.
Workforce and attendance signals can inform the decisions that follow the pay cycle.

questions.question: What is restaurant tip management software?
questions.answer: It supports the rules, calculations, review steps and handoff required to manage tips across restaurant roles, locations and pay periods.

questions.question: Does tip management need to connect to payroll?
questions.answer: Tip workflows are most useful when their review and evidence can move into payroll readiness or a partner handoff without recreating the work in another spreadsheet.

questions.question: How does Sundae connect tip workflows to operations?
questions.answer: Crew connects tip and workforce workflows to scheduling, attendance, payroll readiness and the wider decision-intelligence layer so teams can review what changed and why.
